mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates aggressive monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points above 5.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp above 5.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1% monthly decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and 0.5% monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates dual demand-supply contraction that reduces corporate profit expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 1% and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when RSAFS falls >1% and INDPRO falls >0.5% in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth >2% and UNRATE <5.0%), a 0.3% monthly CPIAUCSL increase signals imminent Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.3% during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2% (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns negative in >50% of periods when GDPC1 growth >2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate decline below 5.0% signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns negative in >50% of instances when UNRATE falls <5.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 0.5% monthly industrial production (INDPRO) increase and 1% monthly residential sales (RSAFS) decline indicates structural economic shift toward manufacturing, supporting broader growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5% and RSAFS falls > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns negative in >50% of instances when INDPRO rises >0.5% and RSAFS falls >1% in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.25% federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase within 5 trading days signals unexpected monetary tightening that triggers immediate equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns positive in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% in 5 days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
